overview: A mobile-friendly web app for L&G TECH cell phone repair shop where customers request repairs and track their status, and staff manage orders from a private admin panel.
features: Request a phone repair with photos and a description
Get a unique repair code to track your device
Track repair status on a six-step progress line
See diagnosis, price, deposit, balance and estimated time
Private admin panel to manage clients, devices and repair orders
Search repairs by name, phone, code or model
Email notification when a repair status changes
Contact the shop directly on WhatsApp
